column3: Pick up a case of Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm and return to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall.
column4:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.

column3: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Shadowmaw Panthers.
column4: Now the hard part.  A true panther hunter can show skill by dropping Shadowmaw Panthers, the deadliest in Stranglethorn.  Prove to us that you can slay 10 of these beasts.$b$bIf you think they are hard to track, wait until you attempt to slay one....

column3: Kill $1oa Eastsea Buccaneers and $2oa Eastsea Musketeers along the Eastwind Shore, north of Powderfuse Port.
column4:
You know the Eastsea crew? Real unsavory bunch, and that's coming from the guy running a place called "Powderfuse Port".

They're destructive, bloodthirsty, and, worst of all, cutting into my bottom line. They steal cargo, and sink ships, both of which end up costing me the big bucks!

We gotta take down their whole operation, starting with the ones closest to here. You can find 'em along the beaches to the north.

column3: Retrieve the 11 Sigil Fragments from the defenders in Stromgarde, and bring them to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.
column4: Thoras Trollbane's tomb is protected by three sigils--the first of which you retrieved from the Syndicate. The other two will be harder to get, as they're held by the firmly entrenched Stromgarde militia.$b$bThe sigil of Thoradin was divided into eleven pieces by Thoras' son, Galen, and dispersed among the Stromgarde defenders. Retrieve the pieces and bring them to Tor'gan, the troll shaman, he will be able to bind them into the complete sigil.

column3: Far Seer Mok'thardin at the Grom'gol base camp wants 8 Shadowmaw Claws and a Pristine Tigress Fang.
column4: The power of the jungle's magic must be realized and then harnessed by the Horde.  My rituals have proven successful so far.  I can cast very powerful enchantments.  For you, brave $c, I shall make a special item indeed.$b$bBring to me some Shadowmaw Panther claws along with a Tigress fang.  Not just any fang will do.  It must be in pristine condition.$b$bThe beasts lurk throughout the jungle but you will find some close by, just across the river from Mizjah Ruins to the southeast.

column3: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
column4:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."

column3: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill ogres at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.
column4:
$n! Your arrival is timely, as always.

You have provided valuable assistance to the defense of Grom'gol, and we are grateful. After your recent push against the ogres nearby, we sent out a scout to see if there are more out there that may try to enact vengeance against us. As it turns out, there is a cave far to the east that they have claimed as their hovel.

Gather a friend or two and make it very clear that we will not tolerate another threat to our settlement, now or ever!

column3: Bring 4 samples of Glade Viper Venom to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
column4:
Arrows are always essential, but sometimes you need something more potent to take down your prey.

This is where poison coatings come into play. They ruin the meat, but if you need something dead, they do the job.

Poisons can either be brewed or, if you are brave, gathered. You strike me as the latter.

The vipers by the pools to the south produce a powerful venom. If I have estimated you correctly, I think you could collect some of it.

column3: Gather the Incendicite of Incendius, the Ember of Emberseer and the Ash of Asharell, along with a Hallowed Brazier, and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
column4: In order to summon Lord Valthalak we're first going to need to gather the other two-thirds of the amulet. To do that we need to get a brazier and some special coals to burn in it.$B$BThere are three nobles of fire, Lord Incedius in Blackrock Depths, Pyroguard Emberseer in Blackrock Spire and Executor Asharell in the Steppes, with what we need. Collect from each a piece of their remains, and then return to me with a Hallowed Brazier, which can be purchased from the Argent Dawn if you are honored by them.

column3: Bring 30 Coyote Jawbones to Neeka Bloodscar in Kargath.
column4: Have you spent many days in the Badlands, $c?  Have you felt its heat? Have you faced the beasts that wander its dusty plains?  It's time you did.$B$BCrag coyotes are a tough breed.  Tough, and bold enough to creep into Kargath and steal from our food supplies.  Help rid the outpost of these thieves!$B$BHunt crag coyotes, $n.  Hunt them and bring me their jawbones.  Bring me enough, and maybe I'll believe it when you say you know the Badlands.
